name: scientific_rag_benchmark_v1
description: 20 questions over the bundled 10-paper corpus. gold_docs are doc_id prefixes; the runner resolves them against the live index. Categories: factual, comparison, methodology, gap, multi_hop.

questions.question: How much does hybrid retrieval improve recall at ten over BM25 alone?
questions.notes: Single-paper numeric question; the number must be quoted, not paraphrased.

questions.question: What fusion method do the hybrid retrieval authors use for their ranked lists?
questions.notes: Terminology recall question.

questions.question: What latency does full cross-encoder reranking cost compared with a pruned cascade?
questions.notes: Two numbers from one paper's results section.

questions.question: How many candidates should a cascade keep before reranking?
questions.notes: Operating-point question.

questions.question: What is the unsupported-claim rate of the multi-agent system compared with single-call RAG?
questions.notes: Headline comparison of the multi-agent paper.

questions.question: Which agents does the coordinator hand off to in the multi-agent pipeline?
questions.notes: Architecture question; expects the agent list.

questions.question: How much does citation validation reduce unsupported citations?
questions.notes: Requires the two-sided result (removed vs retained).

questions.question: What token overlap threshold does the citation validator use for claim support?
questions.notes: Implementation detail; tests whether the methods section is retrieved.

questions.question: How does section-aware chunking improve recall for limitation statements?
questions.notes: Numeric result with a before/after pair.

questions.question: Why can fixed-length chunking hurt retrieval of method statements?
questions.notes: Explanation question; accepts evidence from either paper.

questions.question: What recall improvement does acronym-aware query expansion produce?
questions.notes: Numeric recall question.

questions.question: Why can too much query expansion hurt precision?
questions.notes: Causal question whose answer is a caveat in the results section.

questions.question: How accurate is cue-phrase matching for detecting research gaps?
questions.notes: Precision value with the method name.

questions.question: What are the common failure modes when detecting research gaps?
questions.notes: Limitations question; single-agent baselines typically retrieve the wrong section.

questions.question: Which faithfulness quantity is rarely measured in RAG evaluation?
questions.notes: Requires distinguishing the three quantities.

questions.question: How well does token-overlap support checking agree with human labels?
questions.notes: Cross-paper numeric question.

questions.question: Which four fields are extracted when comparing methodologies across papers?
questions.notes: Schema question.

questions.question: What is the most common cause of failed reproduction in retrieval experiments?
questions.notes: Ranking question over reported causes.

questions.question: Compare how the multi-agent and single-call approaches handle citation validation.
questions.notes: Multi-document comparison; needs the methodology-comparison agent.

questions.question: What open problems remain for evaluating retrieval-augmented scientific answering?
questions.notes: Synthesis question over three papers' limitation sections.
